_comment: The figure is generated by scripts/generate_method_diagram.py but its VALUES are
hand-entered constants, so nothing recomputes them when results change.
tests/test_method_diagram_numbers.py recomputes each from results/ and fails if
the figure has gone stale. If a test here fails, the figure must be redrawn, not

patching_text_all_pct.note: Gemma arm is behavioral valence on the championship/funeral pair, matching the ports.

joy_to_sadness.note: The figure now shows the arrow labels joy->sadness and sadness->joy rather than the 57/62 count; the count is still checked because it is what licenses the arrow.

mirror_contrast.note: Panel A headline. Per-photograph average, NOT asymmetry_vs_floor, which differences cell means and gives +0.478 on the same data.

direction_effects.note: Panel A rows: negative text on a positive photo, positive text on a negative photo, each against that photo's own neutral-context baseline. Bars are drawn to scale.
